wf.leaveDescription: Routed by days: over 2 days adds the director, over 5 days HR as well

node.twoLevels: Two levels of supervisors in turn

tpl.generalDescription: Any request, approved by the initiator's supervisor
tpl.leaveDescription: Days computed from the start and end dates: up to 3 days the supervisor approves, over 3 days two levels of supervisors in turn
tpl.expenseDescription: By the total of the items: up to 5,000 the supervisor approves, over 5,000 two levels of supervisors in turn

timeout.autoPass: Not handled in time; approved automatically
timeout.autoReject: Not handled in time; rejected automatically
timeout.toManager: Not handled in time; transferred to the assignee's superior
timeout.toAdmin: Not handled in time; transferred to a process manager
timeout.remindOnly: Not handled in time and nobody to transfer it to; the assignee was reminded. Someone with process admin rights should reassign it under Approval tasks.
timeout.failed: Not handled in time and automatic handling failed (for example, nobody can review the next step); the assignee was reminded. Someone with process admin rights should reassign it under Approval tasks.
